relations: Fragmented liquid strands merge as the central column thickens into a continuous, reflective ribbon.
The thickening column broadens into a shadowed sheet, causing crisp droplet details to blur and fade.
As the liquid sheet expands, the surrounding fine spray persists while the background defocuses into vertical color bands.
The upper right blurred forms remain static while the central flow's increasing volume dominates the frame.
caption:
A vertical stream of clear liquid moves through a near-black space. Its body wavers and breaks into narrow strands and bright droplets. A fine spray scatters around the column while a soft pinkish form and a small orange shape remain blurred at the upper right. The flow appears already moving, with clumps forming along its center, and the dark background makes each highlight stand out sharply.

As the stream continues, the central column becomes visibly thicker and more continuous. It changes from a fragmented thread into a darker ribbon with reflective streaks and a wavy surface. The surrounding spray persists, and the column gradually occupies more of the frame. Later, the liquid broadens into a shadowed sheet, then loses crisp detail. In the later frames the scene darkens and defocuses, revealing a vertical band of green, purple, and pink pattern left of center, with the blurred pinkish form still present at the upper right corner.
